በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
ወአልባሰ: ልብስ — and garments (ወ- + plural አልባስ, accusative)
ላቲ: ለ — for her (preposition ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ)
መጠነ: መጠን — measure; መጠነ 'as far as, according to the measure of' (construct as conjunction/preposition)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of
ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
ሎቱ: ለ — to him, for him (preposition ለ- with 3m sg suffix -tu: ሎቱ)
ዘኢይነቅዝ: ነቀዘ — which does not rot (ዘ- relative + ኢ- negative + 3ms imperfect, n-q-z 'be worm-eaten, decay')
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, with (preposition) · 'where' as a place conjunction (ኀበ ትነብር 'where she dwells'; ch. 17–19 headings)
ወነሥአ: ነሥአ — and he took (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
በአምሳል: አምሳል — by likeness, in an image (በ- 'by, in' + noun)
በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ)
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ለእለ: እለ — to those who (ለ- 'to' + relative pronoun pl.)
አብ: አብ — father (the Father) · a father in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ)
ማውታ: ሙት — the dead; carrion (plural ማውታ, cf. ዕጓለ ማውታ 'orphan', lit. 'child of the dead'; sense here uncertain)
ወይፈትሕ: ፈትሐ — and he judges, sets free (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, f-t-ḥ)
ወቦቱ: በ — and with it (ወ- + preposition በ- with 3ms suffix ቦቱ)
ወአራዊት: አርዌ — and wild beasts (ወ- + plural አራዊት)
ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n)
ወርቅ: ወርቅ — gold (noun; ንዋየ ወርቅ 'vessels of gold')
